plugins.name: rocalytics
plugins.description: Add @rocapine/rocalytics-sdk to an Expo app and wire it end to end: the Rocalytics client (install, identify, purchases from Superwall, RevenueCat or native paywalls), onboarding run tracking and paywall presentation tracking through @rocapine/react-native-onboarding, and product analytics to the Rocalytics warehouse. Also sets up Adjust (react-native-adjust): tokens from the publishing platform, attribution into Rocalytics, user_converted with Meta dedup ids and store subscription tracking.
